about: The issuers the foundation's index trusts, by the issuer's key as a registry row holds it (128 hex characters, x then y of its point on Baby Jubjub), each with the index's weight for it from 0 to 1. A registry row counts here only when its issuer's key is named here. This is the index's opinion, not a rule: another index trusts other issuers. On devnet, the one is the foundation's devnet issuer, built from issuer/, named issuer.devnet.forest.foundation; a row does not say which tier the person's note was, so every row from it weighs the same.
